assess_software_migration.title: Assess Software Migration
assess_software_migration.description: Assess an installed Windows application for migration using uninstall-registry metadata. Read-only; performs no move, uninstall, install, or junction.

preview_winget_reinstall.title: Preview WinGet Reinstall
preview_winget_reinstall.description: Build a structured WinGet install --location preview for an exact package identifier. Read-only; does not execute WinGet.

prepare_migration.title: Prepare Software Migration
prepare_migration.description: Build a controlled migration plan with a registry snapshot, orchestration steps, and rollback guidance. Read-only; performs no uninstall or install.

execute_winget_install.title: Execute WinGet Install
execute_winget_install.description: Execute a reviewed WinGet install, optionally with --location, after migration preconditions are satisfied.

verify_migration.title: Verify Software Migration
verify_migration.description: Verify the installed application's registry location against the requested migration target.

execute_winget_uninstall.title: Execute WinGet Uninstall
execute_winget_uninstall.description: Execute an exact WinGet uninstall with silent/noninteractive flags and verify the uninstall registry entry is gone.

execute_registered_uninstaller.title: Execute Registered Uninstaller
execute_registered_uninstaller.description: Execute the exact uninstaller registered by the selected software with explicit additional arguments; verify the uninstall registry entry disappears.

elevated_uninstall_status.title: Elevated Uninstall Status
elevated_uninstall_status.description: Read the worker/UAC status and uninstall-registry result for a previously launched elevated registered uninstaller.

elevation_broker_status.title: Elevation Broker Status
elevation_broker_status.description: Read liveness, heartbeat, session, window-station and desktop context for the Interactive Elevation Broker.

execute_elevated_winget_install.title: Execute Elevated WinGet Install
execute_elevated_winget_install.description: Queue an exact reviewed WinGet install with --location through the Interactive Elevation Broker.

elevated_install_status.title: Elevated Install Status
elevated_install_status.description: Read and semantically verify a broker-mediated WinGet install against the requested target directory.
